name: AWS Data Transfer Out - NEGATIVE: egress rates not accessible via static fetch
price_basis: No price recorded. AWS egress pricing is JS-rendered and was not accessible via static HTML fetch on 2026-10-04.
notes: NEGATIVE SUPPLY RECORD. AWS egress pricing could not be extracted from the static HTML of the EC2 pricing page. The page confirms that AWS uses tiered pricing based on aggregate monthly Data Transfer Out, with 100 GB/month free, but the specific per-GB rates are rendered client-side. This is a known barrier for cost modeling. Egress is a significant cost component for inference workloads that serve model outputs to users - a 1MB output per request at 1M requests/month = 1TB/month of egress. AWS egress rates are known to be approximately $0.09/GB for the first 10TB/month (based on prior knowledge, NOT verified in this fetch), but this figure should be verified via the AWS Price List API or Pricing Calculator before use in cost models.
